# f5xc_dns_zone (Resource)

DNS Zone object is used for configuring Primary and Secondary DNS zones.<br><br>User configures zone 'example.com'<br><br>Status for this object will show following<br><br>* List of nameservers<br><br>User can configure DNS records for a Primary zone and a Secondary zone will<br>transfer the DNS records from the primary DNS servers.

To get more information about f5xc_dns_zone, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/dns-zone)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Dns Zone - Full

resource "f5xc_dns_zone" "example" {
  name        = "example-dns-zone-vvg93b-248000.example.com"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "DNS zone example"

  labels = {
    env  = "acceptance"
    team = "example-team"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner    = "dns-team"
    scenario = "list-growth"
  }

  dns_type_choice = {
    primary = {
      soa_record_parameters_choice = {
        default_soa_parameters = true
      }
      default_rr_set_group = [
        {
          description = "public web record"
          ttl         = 300
          type_record_set_choice = {
            a_record = {
              name   = "www.example-dns-zone-vvg93b-248000.example.com"
              values = ["192.168.1.10"]
            }
          }
        }

      ]
      rr_set_group = [
        {
          metadata = {
            name        = "app-records"
            description = "application records"
          }
          rr_set = [
            {
              description = "app record"
              ttl         = 120
              type_record_set_choice = {
                a_record = {
                  name   = "app.example-dns-zone-vvg93b-248000.example.com"
                  values = ["10.10.0.10"]
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        },
        {
          metadata = {
            name        = "api-records"
            description = "api records"
          }
          rr_set = [
            {
              description = "api record"
              ttl         = 300
              type_record_set_choice = {
                a_record = {
                  name   = "api.example-dns-zone-vvg93b-248000.example.com"
                  values = ["10.10.0.20"]
                }
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `dns_type_choice` (Attributes) Choice to DNS zone type Select type of zone whether its primary or secondary<br>Exactly one of `primary` or `secondary` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_type_choice))
- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) annotations Annotations is an unstructured key value map stored with a resource that may be set by external tools to store and retrieve arbitrary metadata. They are not queryable and should be preserved when modifying objects.
- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `namespace_rbac` (Attributes) Namespace RBAC Namespace-based access control configuration for the DNS zone. Updates require a role that carries the f5xc-dns-standard-admin API group, such as f5xc-dns-management-admin. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespace_rbac))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `num_of_dns_records` (Number) Number of DNS records Number of DNS records displays number of dns records for each zone
- `uid` (String) uid uid is the unique in time and space value for this object. Object create will fail if provided by the client and the value exists in the system. Typically generated by the server on successful creation of an object and is not allowed to change once populated. Shadowed by SystemObjectMeta's uid field.

Optional:

- `flags` (String) Flags Flag to control aspects of the rewriting and interpretation of the fields in the record. At this time only four flags, S/A/U/P, are defined.<br>**Default:** ``<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(255)`

- `replacement` (String) Replacement The next NAME to query for NAPTR, SRV, or address records depending on the value of the flags field.<br>**Default:** ``
- `service` (String) Protocol Resolution Service Specifies the service(s) available down this rewrite path.<br>**Default:** ``<br>**Validation:** `Length LengthAtMost(255)`

### Nested Schema for `dns_type_choice.secondary.tsig_key_value.secret_info_choice.blindfold_secret_info`

Required:

Optional:

When disabled, any namespace can use this zone. Control which namespaces can use this zone for HTTP Load Balancer domains and auto-cert. Changes are restricted to DNS administrators. <a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_dns_zone.example <namespace>/<name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<name>"
	to = f5xc_dns_zone.example
}
```
